scope: Canonical name/description/parameters projection for relative schema size checks; not the exact host wire format

tools.name: ctx_find
tools.description: Search local Trivium graph memory by keywords, meaning (when embeddings are enabled), and entity relationships. Relevant expired decisions remain searchable, marked stale and ranked lower; treat them as historical, not current instructions. Set include_stale=false for current facts only. Returns L0 summaries and edge paths. Call ctx_read for full text.

include_stale.description: Include relevant expired memories (default true). Expired hits are marked stale.

tools.name: ctx_read
tools.description: Read one memory node by numeric id returned from ctx_find. Includes incoming about/decided/broke/fixed edges.

tools.name: ctx_remember
tools.description: Store a durable fact as an entity, preference, decision, or experience. Do not store secrets or one-off task instructions.

until.description: Optional explicit expiry, only when the user states this fact expires: YYYY-MM-DD, weekday (Friday / 周五), or 下周. A date mentioned in the fact is not an expiry.

link_to.description: Optional existing node id to link.

link_label.description: Edge label when link_to is set.

tools.name: ctx_link
tools.description: Create a directed edge between two memory node ids.
